definitions.explanation: Formal/honorific expression asking for forgiveness or understanding.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦おかけします→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、ご{容赦|ようしゃ}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: We apologize for the inconvenience; please bear with us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご{容赦|ようしゃ}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please understand if items are out of stock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何卒|なにとぞ}→何卒：19658_nanitozo⟧ご{容赦|ようしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧、⟦お{願|ねが}い{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→願う：02387_negau⟧。
examples.english: We humbly ask for your forgiveness.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧ (honorific prefix) + ⟦{容赦|ようしゃ}→容赦：12288_yousha⟧ (pardon, leniency).
- ご{容赦|ようしゃ}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please bear with us
- ご{容赦|ようしゃ}⟦{願|ねが}います→願う：02387_negau⟧: we ask your understanding
- ご{容赦|ようしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧: adds a further layer of formality
- ⟦{何卒|なにとぞ}→何卒：19658_nanitozo⟧ご{容赦|ようしゃ}〜: the most humble version, standard in written apologies

REGISTER:
Very formal, and directed outward from an organization to its customers or audience. Learners will meet it far more often reading than speaking — in service announcements, business correspondence, official apologies, and posted notices. It is not used between friends.

WHAT IT ACTUALLY ASKS FOR:
Despite the "forgiveness" gloss, ご{容赦|ようしゃ}ください rarely follows a real wrongdoing. It asks the reader to accept an inconvenience in advance — a delay, a shortage, a limit on service — and is closer to English "please bear with us" or "we appreciate your understanding."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→了承：11415_ryoushou⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please note and accept — used for facts the reader must simply acknowledge
- ⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please understand the reasoning
- ⟦お{許|ゆる}しください→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: please forgive — for an actual fault, and less institutional
